messages.speaker: me
messages.text: morning. have you booked anything for mum's seventieth, or are we both pretending it's next year

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: im pretending. has anita sent the guest list, or is she still 'writing it up'?

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: sent it tuesday. 24 people, plus the cousins' kids apparently

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: 24. the hall seats 40, so we're safe on numbers at least

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: we are. do we do food ourselves or get it catered

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: cater. mum will offer to cook and you have to say no 🙂

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: i rehearsed the line. she said fine and then made three trays of the square thing anyway

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: of course she did 🙂 the anniversary is just her cooking's coronation

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: framing that. and the cake? real cake or the plum thing

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: plum thing. non negotiable, it's in the constitution

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: i'll ask anita to guard it. the plum thing claims my dignity every year

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: she says cake is sorted. i think she ordered it at a bakery

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: quietly at a bakery?? after all her speeches about bought cake

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: she'll deny it until the party. don't be a witness 🎂

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: anita booked the hall. invitations need to go out this week — she flies out on the 22nd

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: ok. paper invites for the aunties or digital for everyone?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: digital for everyone, but print six for the ones who still frame things

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: the framers. i'll write the dates carefully this time

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: please. last year's card said the 30th and we still hear about it

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: that was your fault entirely

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: i know. wrong date, then blame the printer — my signature move

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: consistent at least. dani asked what time it starts

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: doors at five — can you confirm with him by wednesday? mum keeps counting him as a yes

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: he won't commit until he's seen the menu. i'll mention the plum thing

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: then he's a lock

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: my gift ideas are bad though, help

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: the photo album you never finish. finish it

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: party in a week. did you write that run sheet yet, or do i have to chase anita's ghost while she's away?

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: writing it now, promise. doors at 5, food at 6, speeches after cake or before

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: after. mum cries at speeches, feed her first

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: wise. and who's talking

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: i do the short one, you do the funny one, anita's facts arrive by email apparently

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: her facts will be a custody hearing for the bean soup recipe

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: bean soup history will be presented, it's tradition now

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: run sheet is sent. anything for the kids table

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: colouring stuff. ask jana, she has a box left from the christening

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: i'll text her tonight. weirdly on track

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: don't jinx it 🙂

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: final jinx: sunday i collect you at half four, hall by five?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: yep. bring the good tape
